# Webhooks (community, Node only)

POSTs a JSON message to each URL in **Send to** when a page is created, updated or deleted, or the site is saved. Messages are signed with `X-HAX-Signature: sha256=<HMAC>` using the secret, and sent from detached hooks.

The destinations are chosen by admins, so `egress` names a setting (`- setting: endpoints`) instead of fixed hosts. Only the hosts of those URLs are reachable. Saving refuses http and private addresses, and a deployment may forbid setting-based egress altogether.

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| hook | `config.before.save` | configuration is about to be written (dashboard, `hax plugin config set`, install migration) | Refuses endpoints that are not https URLs or that point at private addresses. |
| hook | `page.after.save` | the page was written to disk (detached) | Sends a signed page.created or page.updated message to every endpoint. |
| hook | `page.after.delete` | the page was deleted (detached) | Sends a signed page.deleted message to every endpoint. |
| hook | `manifest.after.save` | site.json was written (detached) | Sends a signed site.updated message to every endpoint when the site manifest changes. |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs`.
